title: plan_clarify_check exhausts planClarifyRounds
intent: Pin plan_clarify_check's loop bound: three unresolved clarification rounds route to graceful_failure rather than looping forever.

assumptions: The fixture repository is a TypeScript package with Vitest.

clarificationQuestions.question: Better in which respect — validation, ergonomics or performance?
clarificationQuestions.recommendation: Each implies a different plan; pick one.

spec.description: A two-sprint fixture plan used by the golden dataset to pin the shape of a materialised plan.

features.title: Parse the new config block
features.description: Accept the new block, validate it and surface a typed error when it is malformed.
acceptanceCriteria: A malformed block produces a typed error rather than a crash.
